_comment: Determinex Rosetta Stone Dynamic Registry — the package manager manifest for cross-architecture latent bridge weights.
_doc: Determinex pings this file on startup. If remote version > local version for any family, the client pulls the delta weight file and calls RosettaStone.load_family_extension(). Clients never need to retrain. Contributors submit new families via PR.
_sha256_note: PLACEHOLDER_RUN_sha256sum_TO_FILL entries are intentional — filled at release time when weight files are uploaded to GitHub Releases. Run: sha256sum family_<arch>.pt and paste the hex digest here before tagging a release.
_dims_note: hub_dim MUST match D_ROSETTA in train_rosetta_bases.py (currently 4096). family_dim must match the model's input embedding dimension (general.embedding_length in GGUF header). Verify with: python scripts/determinex_rosetta.py probe <model-tag>

llama.description: Meta Llama 3.x / Mistral-7B. Covers Llama-3.x, Mistral-7B, Hermes, Dolphin, WizardLM, OpenHermes, Zephyr, and all derived fine-tunes. determinex-sentinel-v3 uses this arch (reports general.architecture=llama).

qwen2.description: Alibaba Qwen 2.5 7B (Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct). Hidden dim 3584. Covers Qwen-Coder-7B, Qwen2.5-Instruct-7B, DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen-7B.

qwen2_3b.description: Alibaba Qwen 2.5 3B (Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct). Hidden dim 2048. determinex-observer-v5-dsl uses this arch. Pending: rosetta_v1.pt retrain to include this arch.

qwen2_1b5.description: Alibaba Qwen 2.5 1.5B (Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B-Instruct). Hidden dim 1536. determinex-engineer-v10-dsl uses this arch.

deepseek2.description: DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite (deepseek-coder-v2-lite-instruct). Hidden dim 4096. Covers DeepSeek-Coder-V2, DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1.

phi3.description: Microsoft Phi-3-mini (Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct). Hidden dim 3072. Covers Phi-3, Phi-3.5, Phi-4.

gemma.description: Google Gemma 2 (gemma-2-2b-it). Hidden dim 2304. Covers Gemma 2/3, CodeGemma, ShieldGemma.
